name: Blunt broom sedge
desc: Blunt broom sedge (Carex tribuloides): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Carex tribuloides, the blunt broom sedge, is a species of flowering plant in the genus Carex, native to the eastern United States, eastern Canada, and Veracruz in Mexico, and introduced in Sweden.
